summary.title: Monorepo Explained
summary.one_liner: A resource introducing what monorepos are, their benefits, and what to look for in monorepo tooling.
takeaways: A monorepo keeps multiple projects or packages in a single repository.
Repository boundaries can cause context loss, duplicated setup, and manual coordination of cross-cutting changes.
Setting up a monorepo correctly is presented as an increasingly core developer skill, especially with AI agents.
The page points to guidance on what to look for in monorepo tooling.
summary.summary: The page is a short introductory resource on monorepos. It argues that repository boundaries create friction for developers and AI agents, including context loss across repos, duplicated setup, and manual coordination of cross-cutting changes. It states that its purpose is to explain what monorepos are, what benefits they bring, and what to look for in monorepo tooling. The excerpt available contains little detail beyond this framing, so specific tools and techniques are not covered in the text provided.
